description: Use this when the user asks about the quality of an NBA player's or team's shots, expected field-goal percentage (xFG%), who makes more or fewer shots than expected, or the quality of shots a defense allows. Returns, for a player_id, his season's attempts, FG% against xFG%, eFG% against xeFG%, three-point rate, shot making (points over expected per 100 shots) and his rank in it; for a team_id, the same for its offense and for the shots its defense allowed; with neither, the season's best and worst shot makers (200+ attempts). Requires Keel Stats Pro; the answer says so when the account has none. Not for box-score shooting splits: use player_profile.

league.description: League: "nba" (shot quality is modelled for the NBA).

player_id.description: Optional numeric player ID from search.

season.description: Optional season year. Defaults to the latest season with games played.

team_id.description: Optional numeric team ID from search.

name: shot_quality
